goal: Allow Bitcoin Core users to send funds to BIP 352 silent payment addresses
Provides enhanced privacy and prevents address reuse when sending from wallet RPCs or the GUI
agreement: Strong support with full consensus on the approach
Verified compatibility across 315 transactions using btclib-wallet (fametrano)
Verified key filtering in coin selection and fee bumper index handling pass tests (Yudis-bit)
Concept approval without stated reasons (rkrux, w0xlt, rustaceanrob, polespinasa)

categories.name: wallet
why: P2 because it delivers a major privacy upgrade to wallet users by preventing on-chain address reuse
Unblocks subsequent BIP 352 silent payments wallet work
